title: Find Proteins of Unknown Function (PUFs) using Plantannot - Protocol D
author: Marcos Viana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgd6js9e

steps.title: Open Plantannot search page
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Plantannot results page with empty filters using either https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q= or the main Plantannot page and click the magnifying‑glass icon with the search box empty.

steps.title: Set organism filter
steps.instruction: In the "Organisms" filter on the left, expand the list with the green arrow and select any organism (example: Oropetium thomaeum) or leave all boxes empty, then click "apply". Resulting URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum

steps.title: Set feature type filter
steps.instruction: In the "Feature type" filter, choose "polypeptide" and click "apply". Resulting URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide

steps.title: Set orthology filter
steps.instruction: In the Orthology filter, select "orthology" and click "apply". Resulting URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1

steps.title: Set co‑expression filter
steps.instruction: In the "Orthologs_coexpression" filter, choose "co‑expression" and click "apply". Resulting URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue

steps.title: Set analyses filters
steps.instruction: In the "Analyses" filter, select both "no diamond matches" and "no interproscan matches", then click "apply". Resulting URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+interproscan+matches

steps.title: View resulting PUF list
steps.instruction: After all filters are applied, the "Results" card on the centre‑right displays the list of Oropetium thomaeum PUFs linked to abiotic stress via orthology and co‑expression; 10 PUFs are shown. Final URL: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+interproscan+matches
